APPF should remain a reference anchor for property-management SaaS within the housing infrastructure lane, but future layers need to test valuation attention, value-added-services quality, and housing-cycle sensitivity.

summary: Expanded the universe around sticky transaction infrastructure for travel and housing. The best-fitting Layer 1B candidates are vertical workflow systems rather than consumer-facing brands: hospitality PMS/POS software, rental property-management SaaS, mortgage-origination workflow software, and home-services/inspection/title/mortgage data networks.
